name: Tokenization and structure-aware representation engineering
coreIdea: Injecting musical structure into the token vocabulary — metre, polyphony, track identity — proved cheaper and more effective than redesigning the network.
whyItMatters: Representation choice was a substantive scientific question whose answers became the field's shared infrastructure.

name: Controllability as a persistent research axis
coreIdea: Control migrates from the latent space, to the training objective, and finally to the sampling process of a frozen model.
whyItMatters: Controllability turns generation systems into usable creative tools and is the property most consistently evaluated.

name: Paradigm evolution: from autoregressive tokens to iterative refinement
coreIdea: Autoregression discretises and streams; diffusion offers whole-context, non-causal generation with control; flow matching and state-space backbones emerge as successors. The result is a division of labour, not replacement.
whyItMatters: This evolution supplies the generative machinery of the entire second half of the corpus.

name: Language as the interface: text-to-music and LLM-based composition
coreIdea: Language enters first as the conditioning signal, then as the model itself — importing dialogue, reasoning and tool use into composition.
whyItMatters: Language collapsed the entry barrier to music generation and imported interactive workflows into composition.

name: Large-scale pretraining and music foundation models
coreIdea: The unit of progress shifts from the task-specific architecture to the reusable pretrained checkpoint — understanding first, generation second.
whyItMatters: It changes what counts as a contribution and sets the field's working assumptions at the review's endpoint.

name: Arrangement matures: from accompaniment to stem-aware co-creation
coreIdea: Arrangement moves from autonomous accompaniment to responding to material a human actually provides — audio, vocals, existing stems.
whyItMatters: Arrangement is where the corpus moves most decisively toward assistive, context-aware musicianship.

name: Orchestration: from optimization to neural modeling
coreIdea: Orchestration recapitulates the field's evolution — optimisation, representation engineering, controllable deep models — but compressed, delayed and under-populated.
whyItMatters: It establishes the clearest research gap in the corpus, directly motivating this thesis's orchestration focus.

name: Efficiency, alignment, and evaluation maturity
coreIdea: Once capability was established, research turned inward — making generation fast (non-autoregressive, distillation), aligned (RLHF) and measurable (benchmarking, bias analysis).
whyItMatters: Deployment, alignment and measurement validity jointly determine whether reported progress is real and usable.
